title.en: Unit 6: Choosing a Career, Reading, and Bilal
title.ur: Chhatha Unit: Pesha chunna, Parhna aur Bilal

title.en: How do you choose your career?

intro.en: Allah created people different, so they serve each other through different jobs. The text explains how a young person can know himself and choose a suitable career. Then come exercises on the text and its words.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum seekhenge ke Allah ne logon ko mukhtalif banaya hai taake woh alag alag kaam karke ek doosre ki khidmat karein. Text batata hai ke naujawan apne aap ko pehchan kar munasib pesha kaise chune. Phir text aur alfaz ki mashqein hain.
intro.ar: خَلَقَ اللهُ النّاسَ مُخْتَلِفينَ فَتَنَوَّعَتْ مِهَنُهُمْ لِيَخْدِمَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا. يَشْرَحُ النَّصُّ كَيْفَ يَعْرِفُ الشّابُّ نَفْسَهُ وَيَخْتارُ المِهْنَةَ المُناسِبَةَ، ثُمَّ تَأْتي تَمارينُ عَلَى النَّصِّ وَمُفْرَداتِهِ.

dialogue.ar: خَلَقَ اللهُ الخَلْقَ مُخْتَلِفينَ: في أَنْفُسِهِم، وَفي قُدُراتِهِم، وَفي أَعْمالِهِم.
dialogue.tr: khalaqa llāhu l-khalqa mukhtalifīn: fī anfusihim, wa fī qudurātihim, wa fī aʿmālihim
dialogue.en: Allah created people different: in their selves, their abilities and their work.
dialogue.ur: Allah ne logon ko mukhtalif paida kiya: apni zaat mein, apni salahiyaton mein aur apne kaamon mein.

dialogue.ar: وَالبَشَرُ مُسَخَّرٌ بَعْضُهُم لِبَعْض.
dialogue.tr: wal-basharu musakhkharun baʿḍuhum li-baʿḍ
dialogue.en: People are made to serve one another.
dialogue.ur: Insaan ek doosre ke kaam aane ke liye banaye gaye hain.

dialogue.ar: وَلَوْ عَمِلَ النّاسُ كُلُّهُم في مِهْنَةٍ واحِدَةٍ لَتَعَطَّلَتْ بَقِيَّةُ مَصالِحِهِم.
dialogue.tr: wa law ʿamila n-nāsu kulluhum fī mihnatin wāḥidatin la-taʿaṭṭalat baqiyyatu maṣāliḥihim
dialogue.en: If all people worked in one job, the rest of their needs would stop.
dialogue.ur: Agar sab log ek hi pesha karte to baqi zaruraton ka kaam ruk jata.

dialogue.ar: كانَ الشَّبابُ في الماضي يَتَعَلَّمونَ مِهَنَ آبائِهِم في الغالِب.
dialogue.tr: kāna sh-shabābu fī l-māḍī yataʿallamūna mihana ābāʾihim fil-ghālib
dialogue.en: In the past, young people usually learned their fathers' jobs.
dialogue.ur: Pehle naujawan aam tor par apne walid ka pesha seekhte the.

dialogue.ar: فَكَيْفَ يَخْتارُ الشّابُّ مِهْنَتَهُ؟
dialogue.tr: fa-kayfa yakhtāru sh-shābbu mihnatah?
dialogue.en: So how does a young man choose his career?
dialogue.ur: To naujawan apna pesha kaise chune?

dialogue.ar: يَنْبَغي أَنْ يَتَعَرَّفَ إِلى صِفاتِ نَفْسِهِ وَمُيولِهِ.
dialogue.tr: yanbaghī an yataʿarrafa ilā ṣifāti nafsihi wa mayūlih
dialogue.en: He should get to know his own qualities and interests.
dialogue.ur: Use chahiye ke apni khubiyon aur apne rujhanat ko pehchane.

dialogue.ar: وَيَحْتاجُ الشّابُّ إِلى التَّدْريبِ عَلى المِهْنَةِ وَاكْتِسابِ الخِبْرَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa yaḥtāju sh-shābbu ilā t-tadrībi ʿalā l-mihnati wa-ktisābi l-khibrah
dialogue.en: A young man needs training for the job and to gain experience.
dialogue.ur: Naujawan ko pesha seekhne ki training aur tajurba hasil karne ki zarurat hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَضَعُ لِنَفْسِهِ خُطَّةً مَرِنَةً تَسْمَحُ لَهُ بِالتَّغْييرِ وَالتَّصَرُّفِ.
dialogue.tr: wa yaḍaʿu li-nafsihi khuṭṭatan marinatan tasmaḥu lahu bit-taghyīri wat-taṣarruf
dialogue.en: He makes a flexible plan for himself that allows change and adjustment.
dialogue.ur: Woh apne liye lachakdar mansooba banaye jo tabdeeli ki ijazat de.

q.en: Why did Allah create people different in their jobs, according to the text?
q.ur: Text ke mutabiq Allah ne logon ko kaamon mein mukhtalif kyun banaya?
q.ar: لِماذا خَلَقَ اللهُ النّاسَ مُخْتَلِفينَ في مِهَنِهِمْ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

options: So life is run well and they serve each other
options_ar: لِتَسيرَ الحَياةُ جَيِّدًا وَيَخْدِمَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا

q.en: What would happen if all people worked in one job?
q.ur: Agar sab log ek hi pesha karte to kya hota?
q.ar: ماذا يَحْدُثُ لَوْ عَمِلَ النّاسُ جَميعًا في مِهْنَةٍ واحِدَةٍ؟

options: The rest of their needs would stop

q.en: What does «مِهْنَة» mean?
q.ur: «مِهْنَة» ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: عَمَلٌ يَقومُ بِهِ الإِنْسانُ لِيَكْسِبَ رِزْقَهُ

q.en: What should a young man do first before choosing a job?
q.ur: Pesha chunne se pehle naujawan ko pehle kya karna chahiye?
q.ar: ماذا يَفْعَلُ الشّابُّ أَوَّلًا قَبْلَ اخْتِيارِ مِهْنَتِهِ؟

options: Know his own qualities and interests

q.en: What kind of plan should a young man make for himself?
q.ur: Naujawan ko apne liye kaisa mansooba banana chahiye?

options: A fixed plan that never changes

title.en: Grammar A: The noun ending in madd (hamza after alif)

intro.en: A mamdood noun is a noun that ends with alif followed by hamza, like الحَمْراء (red) or الدُّعاء (prayer). When we make it dual (two), the hamza may stay, turn into و, or turn into ي. It depends on where the hamza came from.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum seekhenge ism-e-mamdood: woh lafz jiske aakhir mein alif ke baad hamza ho, jaise الحَمْراء aur الدُّعاء. Jab hum iska tasniya (do) banate hain to hamza kabhi wahi rehta hai, kabhi و ban jata hai, kabhi ي. Yeh is par hai ke hamza kahan se aaya.
intro.ar: الاسْمُ المَمْدودُ اسْمٌ يَنْتَهي بِأَلِفٍ بَعْدَها هَمْزَةٌ، مِثْلُ «الحَمْراء» وَ«الدُّعاء». وَعِنْدَ تَثْنِيَتِهِ قَدْ تَبْقَى الهَمْزَةُ أَوْ تَنْقَلِبُ واوًا أَوْ ياءً بِحَسَبِ أَصْلِها.

vocab.ur: alif aur hamza par khatam hone wala ism

q.en: Which word is a mamdood noun?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz ism-e-mamdood hai?

q.en: What is the dual of «الدُّعاء» (prayer)?
q.ur: «الدُّعاء» ka tasniya kya hai?

q.en: What is the dual of «حَمْراء»?
q.ur: «حَمْراء» ka tasniya kya hai?

q.en: In the dual, what happens to the hamza of a feminine mamdood word like حَمْراء?
q.ur: Tasniya mein muannas mamdood lafz (jaise حَمْراء) ke hamza ka kya hota hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَحْدُثُ لِهَمْزَةِ الاسْمِ المَمْدودِ المُؤَنَّثِ مِثْلِ «حَمْراء» في المُثَنّى؟

q.en: What does «اللِّقاء» mean?
q.ur: «اللِّقاء» ka matlab kya hai?

title.ar: فَهْمُ المَسْموع: كَيْفَ يُحِبُّ أَطْفالُنا القِراءَة
title.en: Listening: How do our children come to love reading?
title.ur: Sunna aur samajhna: Hamare bachche parhna kaise pasand karein

intro.en: Two listening texts about getting children to love reading. After listening, you mark each sentence true or false. Here we read the sentences so you can practise the ideas.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum seekhenge ke bachchon mein parhne ki mohabbat kaise paida ho. Do sunne wale text hain; sunkar har jumle ko sahi ya ghalat batana hota hai. Yahan hum woh jumle parhte hain.
intro.ar: نَصّانِ مَسْموعانِ عَنْ كَيْفِيَّةِ تَحْبيبِ الأَطْفالِ في القِراءَةِ. بَعْدَ الاسْتِماعِ تُحَدِّدُ كُلَّ جُمْلَةٍ صَوابًا أَوْ خَطَأً، وَهُنا نَقْرَأُ الجُمَلَ لِنَتَدَرَّبَ عَلَى الأَفْكارِ.

dialogue.ar: قَلَّلَ النّاسُ مِنَ القِراءَةِ بَعْدَ ظُهورِ الحاسوبِ وَالشَّبَكَةِ الدَّوْلِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: qallala n-nāsu mina l-qirāʾati baʿda ẓuhūri l-ḥāsūbi wash-shabakati d-dawliyya
dialogue.en: People read less after computers and the internet appeared.
dialogue.ur: Computer aur internet ke aane ke baad logon ne parhna kam kar diya.

dialogue.ar: يَجِبُ أَنْ نُعَوِّدَ أَبْناءَنا القِراءَةَ في سِنٍّ مُبَكِّرَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: yajibu an nuʿawwida abnāʾanā l-qirāʾata fī sinnin mubakkira
dialogue.en: We must accustom our children to reading at an early age.
dialogue.ur: Hamein apne bachchon ko chhoti umar se parhne ki aadat dalni chahiye.

dialogue.ar: يُقْبِلُ الطِّفْلُ عَلى القِراءَةِ إِذا كانَ البَيْتُ قارِئاً.
dialogue.tr: yuqbilu ṭ-ṭiflu ʿalā l-qirāʾati idhā kāna l-baytu qāriʾā
dialogue.en: The child turns to reading if the home is a reading home.
dialogue.ur: Agar ghar mein parhne ka mahaul ho to bachcha parhne ki taraf aata hai.

dialogue.ar: يَجِبُ أَنْ تَكونَ قِراءَةُ الطِّفْلِ في البِدايَةِ لِلْمُتْعَةِ.
dialogue.tr: yajibu an takūna qirāʾatu ṭ-ṭifli fil-bidāyati lil-mutʿa
dialogue.en: At the start, a child's reading should be for enjoyment.
dialogue.ur: Shuru mein bachche ka parhna maza lene ke liye hona chahiye.

dialogue.ar: الكِتابُ وَسيلَةٌ لِتَنْمِيَةِ الخَيالِ وَإِثْرائِهِ.
dialogue.tr: al-kitābu wasīlatun li-tanmiyati l-khayāli wa ithrāʾih
dialogue.en: The book is a means to grow and enrich imagination.
dialogue.ur: Kitab takhayyul ko barhane aur ameer karne ka zariya hai.

dialogue.ar: تُنْصَحُ الأُمُّ بِإِحْضارِ الكُتُبِ لِطِفْلِها.
dialogue.tr: tunṣaḥu l-ummu bi-iḥḍāri l-kutubi li-ṭiflihā
dialogue.en: The mother is advised to bring books for her child.
dialogue.ur: Maa ko mashwara diya jata hai ke bachche ke liye kitabein laye.

dialogue.ar: تُنْصَحُ الأُمُّ بِأَلّا تَقْطَعَ عَلى طِفْلِها قِراءَتَهُ لِتَشْرَحَ لَهُ كَلِماتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: tunṣaḥu l-ummu bi-allā taqṭaʿa ʿalā ṭiflihā qirāʾatahu li-tashraḥa lahu kalimātih
dialogue.en: The mother is advised not to interrupt her child's reading to explain every word.
dialogue.ur: Maa ko mashwara hai ke bachche ko beech mein na roke ke har lafz samjhaye.

q.en: What does «القِراءَة» mean?
q.ur: «القِراءَة» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: According to the text, at what age should children get used to reading?
q.ur: Text ke mutabiq bachchon ko kis umar mein parhne ki aadat dalni chahiye?
q.ar: في أَيِّ سِنٍّ يَنْبَغي أَنْ يَعْتادَ الأَطْفالُ القِراءَةَ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: When does a child turn to reading more?
q.ur: Bachcha parhne ki taraf kab zyada aata hai?
q.ar: مَتى يُقْبِلُ الطِّفْلُ عَلَى القِراءَةِ أَكْثَرَ؟

options: When the home is a reading home

q.en: What should a child's reading be for at the start?
q.ur: Shuru mein bachche ka parhna kis liye hona chahiye?

q.en: What is a book a means to grow?
q.ur: Kitab kis cheez ko barhane ka zariya hai?

intro.en: In this lesson you practise talking with a classmate. You choose between two things, say your opinion and give reasons. Try it out loud with the four topics.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum apne sathi se guftagu ki mashq karenge. Do cheezon mein se ek chun kar apni raye aur wajah batate hain. Chaaron mauzuat par zubani koshish karein.
intro.ar: في هَذا الدَّرْسِ تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلَى الحِوارِ مَعَ زَميلٍ: تَخْتارُ بَيْنَ أَمْرَيْنِ وَتَذْكُرُ رَأْيَكَ وَأَسْبابَهُ. جَرِّبْ ذَلِكَ بِصَوْتٍ عالٍ في المَوْضوعاتِ الأَرْبَعَةِ.

dialogue.ar: الدِّراسَةُ في الوَطَنِ أَوِ الدِّراسَةُ خارِجَ الوَطَن.
dialogue.tr: ad-dirāsatu fil-waṭani awi d-dirāsatu khārija l-waṭan
dialogue.en: Studying at home or studying abroad.
dialogue.ur: Watan mein parhna ya watan se bahar parhna.

dialogue.ar: الأَكْلُ في البَيْتِ أَوِ الأَكْلُ في المَطاعِم.
dialogue.tr: al-aklu fil-bayti awi l-aklu fil-maṭāʿim
dialogue.en: Eating at home or eating in restaurants.
dialogue.ur: Ghar mein khana ya restaurant mein khana.

dialogue.ar: قَضاءُ العُطْلَةِ الصَّيْفِيَّةِ في الوَطَنِ أَوْ خارِجَ الوَطَن.
dialogue.tr: qaḍāʾu l-ʿuṭlati ṣ-ṣayfiyyati fil-waṭani aw khārija l-waṭan
dialogue.en: Spending the summer holiday at home or abroad.
dialogue.ur: Garmiyon ki chhutti watan mein ya bahar guzarna.

dialogue.ar: أَيُّهُما أَهَمُّ: السَّيْفُ أَوِ القَلَم؟
dialogue.tr: ayyuhumā ahamm: as-sayfu awi l-qalam?
dialogue.en: Which is more important: the sword or the pen?
dialogue.ur: Kaun sa zyada ahem hai: talwar ya qalam?

q.en: What does «القَلَم» mean?
q.ur: «القَلَم» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: What does «الوَطَن» mean?
q.ur: «الوَطَن» ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: البَلَدُ الَّذي يَعيشُ فيهِ الإِنْسانُ وَيَنْتَمي إِلَيْهِ

q.en: Which question asks about importance?
q.ur: Kaun sa sawal ahmiyat ke bare mein hai?

q.en: What does «العُطْلَة الصَّيْفِيَّة» mean?
q.ur: «العُطْلَة الصَّيْفِيَّة» ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: راحَةٌ مِنَ الدِّراسَةِ في فَصْلِ الصَّيْفِ

title.ar: القَواعِد (ب): جَزْمُ المُضارِعِ في جَوابِ الطَّلَب
title.en: Grammar B: The jussive verb after a request
title.ur: Qawaid (be): Talab ke jawab mein mudari majzoom

intro.en: When a command or a «لا» prohibition is followed by a present-tense verb that is the result of it, that verb takes jazm (sukoon). Example: «أَسْلِمْ تَسْلَمْ» means 'Accept Islam, you will be safe.' The first part is the request, the second is its result.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum seekhenge ke jab hukm ya «لا» se mana karne ke baad aisa mudari fel aaye jo uska nateeja ho, to us par jazm (sukoon) aata hai. Misaal: «أَسْلِمْ تَسْلَمْ» yani 'Islam laao, salamat raho.' Pehla hissa talab hai, doosra uska nateeja.
intro.ar: إِذا جاءَ فِعْلٌ مُضارِعٌ بَعْدَ أَمْرٍ أَوْ نَهْيٍ بِـ«لا» وَكانَ جَوابًا لَهُ جُزِمَ بِالسُّكونِ. مِثالُ ذَلِكَ «أَسْلِمْ تَسْلَمْ»: الأَوَّلُ طَلَبٌ وَالثّاني جَوابُهُ.

dialogue.ar: أَسْلِمْ تَسْلَمْ.
dialogue.tr: aslim taslam
dialogue.en: Submit, you will be safe.
dialogue.ur: Islam laao, salamat rahoge.

dialogue.ar: اِسْتَذْكِرْ دُروسَكَ تَنْجَحْ.
dialogue.tr: istadhkir durūsaka tanjaḥ
dialogue.en: Revise your lessons, you will succeed.
dialogue.ur: Apne sabaq yaad karo, kamyab hoge.

dialogue.ar: اِحْتَرِمِ النّاسَ يَحْتَرِموكَ.
dialogue.tr: iḥtarimi n-nāsa yaḥtarimūk
dialogue.en: Respect people, they will respect you.
dialogue.ur: Logon ki izzat karo, woh teri izzat karenge.

dialogue.ar: لا تَعْصِ اللهَ تُفْلِحْ.
dialogue.tr: lā taʿṣi llāha tufliḥ
dialogue.en: Do not disobey Allah, you will succeed.
dialogue.ur: Allah ki nafarmani na karo, kamyab hoge.

dialogue.ar: لا تَجْلِسْ في الطُّرُقاتِ تَسْلَمْ مِنَ الأَذى.
dialogue.tr: lā tajlis fiṭ-ṭuruqāti taslam mina l-adhā
dialogue.en: Do not sit in the roads, you will be safe from harm.
dialogue.ur: Raaston mein na baitho, takleef se bache rahoge.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَفْعَلُ الخَيْرَ تُؤْجَرْ؟
dialogue.tr: hal tafʿalu l-khayra tu'jar?
dialogue.en: Will you do good and be rewarded?
dialogue.ur: Kya tum bhalai karoge ke ajar paao?

dialogue.ar: أَطْعِمُوا الطَّعامَ وَأَفْشُوا السَّلامَ تورَثوا الجِنانَ.
dialogue.tr: aṭʿimū ṭ-ṭaʿāma wa afshū s-salāma tūrathū l-jinān
dialogue.en: Feed food and spread peace, you will inherit the Gardens.
dialogue.ur: Khana khilao aur salam phailao, jannaton ke waris banoge.

dialogue.ar: وَأَحْسِنْ إِلى جارِكَ تَكُنْ مُؤْمِناً.
dialogue.tr: wa aḥsin ilā jārika takun muʾminā
dialogue.en: Be good to your neighbour, you will be a believer.
dialogue.ur: Apne padosi ke saath bhalai karo, momin banoge.

q.en: What is the jussive form in «أَسْلِمْ ___»?
q.ur: «أَسْلِمْ ___» mein sahi majzoom fel kaun sa hai?

q.en: What does «أَسْلِمْ تَسْلَمْ» mean?
q.ur: «أَسْلِمْ تَسْلَمْ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: In «اِحْتَرِمِ النّاسَ يَحْتَرِموكَ», which part is the request?
q.ur: «اِحْتَرِمِ النّاسَ يَحْتَرِموكَ» mein talab kaun sa hissa hai?
q.ar: في «اِحْتَرِمِ النّاسَ يَحْتَرِموكَ» أَيُّ جُزْءٍ هُوَ الطَّلَبُ؟

q.en: What does «الجار» mean?

title.ar: القِراءَةُ المُوَسَّعَة: بِلالُ بْنُ رَباحٍ مُؤَذِّنُ رَسولِ اللهِ
title.en: Reading: Bilal ibn Rabah, the muadhdhin of the Messenger of Allah
title.ur: Parhna: Bilal bin Rabah, Rasoolullah ﷺ ke muazzin

intro.en: A reading text about the life of Bilal ibn Rabah (may Allah be pleased with him): his birth, his Islam, his patience under torture, his freedom, the first adhan in Madinah and his last days. After it come questions and word exercises.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum Bilal bin Rabah (Allah un se razi ho) ki zindagi parhenge: unki paidaish, Islam, azeeyaton par sabr, aazadi, Madina mein pehli azaan aur aakhri din. Is ke baad sawalat aur alfaz ki mashqein hain.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ عَنْ حَياةِ بِلالِ بْنِ رَباحٍ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ: وِلادَتِهِ وَإِسْلامِهِ وَصَبْرِهِ عَلَى التَّعْذيبِ وَعِتْقِهِ وَأَوَّلِ أَذانٍ في المَدينَةِ وَأَيّامِهِ الأَخيرَةِ. وَبَعْدَهُ أَسْئِلَةٌ وَتَمارينُ عَلَى الكَلِماتِ.

dialogue.ar: وُلِدَ بِلالٌ في السَّراةِ قَبْلَ الهِجْرَةِ بِنَحْوِ ثَلاثٍ وَأَرْبَعينَ سَنَةً.
dialogue.tr: wulida bilālun fis-sarāh qabla l-hijrati bi-naḥwi thalāthin wa arbaʿīna sana
dialogue.en: Bilal was born in As-Sarat about forty-three years before the Hijrah.
dialogue.ur: Bilal hijrat se takreeban teintalees saal pehle As-Sarat mein paida hue.

dialogue.ar: كانَ بِلالٌ مِنَ السّابِقينَ الأَوَّلينَ إِلى الإِسْلام.
dialogue.tr: kāna bilālun mina s-sābiqīna l-awwalīna ilā l-islām
dialogue.en: Bilal was among the first to accept Islam.
dialogue.ur: Bilal Islam laane walon mein sabse pehle logon mein se the.

dialogue.ar: لَقَدْ لَقِيَ بِلالٌ مِنْ أَذى المُشْرِكينَ ما لَمْ يَلْقَهُ سِواهُ.
dialogue.tr: laqad laqiya bilālun min adhā l-mushrikīna mā lam yalqahu siwāh
dialogue.en: Bilal suffered from the polytheists harm that others did not suffer.
dialogue.ur: Bilal ne mushrikeen ki woh takleef sahi jo doosron ne nahin sahi.

dialogue.ar: وَصَبَرَ هُوَ وَمَنْ مَعَهُ مِنَ المُسْتَضْعَفينَ عَلى الابْتِلاءِ في سَبيلِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa ṣabara huwa wa man maʿahu mina l-mustaḍʿafīna ʿalā l-ibtilāʾi fī sabīli llāh
dialogue.en: He and the weak believers with him were patient under the trial for Allah's sake.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne aur unke saath kamzor musalmanon ne Allah ki raah mein azmaish par sabr kiya.

dialogue.ar: فَكانَ بِلالٌ يَسْتَعْذِبُ العَذابَ في سَبيلِ اللهِ، وَيُرَدِّدُ: أَحَدٌ أَحَدٌ.
dialogue.tr: fa-kāna bilālun yastaʿdhibu l-ʿadhāba fī sabīli llāh, wa yuraddidu: aḥadun aḥad
dialogue.en: Bilal found the suffering sweet for Allah's sake and kept repeating: One, One!
dialogue.ur: Bilal Allah ki raah mein azeeyat ko meetha samajhte aur kehte rehte: Ahad, Ahad (Allah ek hai).

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ عَرَضَ أَبو بَكْرٍ الصِّدّيقُ -رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ- عَلى أُمَيَّةَ أَنْ يَشْتَرِيَهُ مِنْهُ.
dialogue.tr: wa qad ʿaraḍa abū bakrin aṣ-ṣiddīqu raḍiya llāhu ʿanhu ʿalā umayyata an yashtariyahu minh
dialogue.en: Abu Bakr as-Siddiq, may Allah be pleased with him, offered to buy him from Umayyah.
dialogue.ur: Abu Bakr siddiq (Allah un se razi ho) ne Umayyah ko peshkash ki ke Bilal ko us se khareed lein.

dialogue.ar: فَاشْتَراهُ مِنْهُ بِتِسْعِ أَواقٍ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-shtarāhu minhu bi-tisʿi awāqin mina dh-dhahab
dialogue.en: So he bought him for nine ounces of gold.
dialogue.ur: Chunancha unhon ne use nau auqiya sone ke badle khareed liya.

dialogue.ar: لَمّا شَيَّدَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ مَسْجِدَهُ في المَدينَةِ وَشُرِعَ الأَذانُ، كانَ بِلالٌ أَوَّلَ مُؤَذِّنٍ في الإِسْلام.
dialogue.tr: lammā shayyada r-rasūlu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam masjidahu fil-madīna wa shuriʿa l-adhān, kāna bilālun awwala muʾadhdhinin fil-islām
dialogue.en: When the Messenger ﷺ built his mosque in Madinah and the adhan was prescribed, Bilal was the first muadhdhin in Islam.
dialogue.ur: Jab Rasoolullah ﷺ ne Madina mein masjid banayi aur azaan muqarrar hui, to Bilal Islam ke pehle muazzin the.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ إِذا فَرَغَ مِنَ الأَذانِ وَقَفَ عَلى بابِ بَيْتِ الرَّسولِ وَقالَ: حَيَّ عَلى الصَّلاةِ، حَيَّ عَلى الفَلاح.
dialogue.tr: wa kāna idhā faragha mina l-adhāni waqafa ʿalā bābi bayti r-rasūli wa qāl: ḥayya ʿalā ṣ-ṣalāh, ḥayya ʿalā l-falāḥ
dialogue.en: When he finished the adhan, he stood at the door of the Messenger's house and said: Come to prayer, come to success.
dialogue.ur: Azaan ke baad woh Rasool ﷺ ke ghar ke darwaze par khade hote aur kehte: namaz ki taraf aao, kamyabi ki taraf aao.

dialogue.ar: وَلَقَدْ ظَلَّ مُمْسِكاً عَنِ الأَذانِ حَتّى قَدِمَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الخَطّابِ بِلادَ الشّام.
dialogue.tr: wa laqad ẓalla mumsikan ʿani l-adhāni ḥattā qadima ʿumaru bnu l-khaṭṭābi bilāda sh-shām
dialogue.en: He stayed away from the adhan until Umar ibn al-Khattab came to Ash-Sham.
dialogue.ur: Woh azaan se ruke rahe yahan tak ke Umar bin Khattab Shaam aaye.

dialogue.ar: غَداً نَلْقى الأَحِبَّةَ... مُحَمَّداً وَصَحْبَه.
dialogue.tr: ghadan nalqā l-aḥibba... muḥammadan wa ṣaḥbah
dialogue.en: Tomorrow we will meet the loved ones: Muhammad and his companions.
dialogue.ur: Kal hum pyaron se milenge: Muhammad ﷺ aur unke sathiyon se.

vocab.ur: unki wafat ka waqt aa gaya

vocab.en: he held back from the adhan
vocab.ur: woh azaan dene se ruk gaye
